maria (Docs): Quick thread 1 PR needs tiny snippet updates: resume-token TTL, jittered retries, and a short fallback to polling. Can we patch py/ts/go examples?

sam (SDK): Ill coordinate. Keep examples tiny  one-liners where possible. Where are files?

maria (Docs): docs/snippets/streaming/, examples/get-started/stream-paginate/README.md, and a one-line callout in docs/guides/pagination.md.

eli (PY SDK): Ill add a Python snippet showing jittered backoff + resume-token save. Draft: ```py
# jittered retry + resume handling
retry = Retry(jitter=True, base=0.1, max=1.5)
for chunk in client.stream(req, retry=retry):
    if getattr(chunk, 'resume_token', None): save(chunk.resume_token)
    print(chunk.text)
```

linda (TS SDK): TS will be async-iterator minimal example and a typing hint. ```ts
for await (const p of client.stream(req)) {
  if (p.resumeToken) save(p.resumeToken)
  console.log(p.text)
}
```

jon (Go eng): Go snippet will show context cancel and reconnection hint. ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for c := range stream.Chunks() { fmt.Println(c.Text) }
// use exp backoff + jitter to reconnect
```

maria (Docs): Editorial notes: 1) add exact sentence: "Resume tokens expire after 24 hours; persist tokens if you may resume." 2) add a one-paragraph fallback: if resume fails, switch to polling pages with pseudocode: ```pseudo
while has_more: page = client.list_pages(cursor); process(page); cursor = page.next_cursor
``` 3) add one-line note: "set batch_size for throughput vs latency trade-offs."

sam (SDK): Got it. Ill update the snippets and push a tiny PR. Will ping when preview is up.
